design_notes: Controller code, controller parameters, model files, model hashes, actuator mapping, references, safety rules, and scorer are frozen.
All v2 scored conditions use zero configured water current; current is handled by a separate physics qualification gate.
Thruster degradation begins at evaluation start. Ramp duration and affected thrusters are queue-controlled and bag-audited.
Health is a multiplicative thrust factor; normalized command is scaled by sqrt(health) under the audited quadratic Stonefish thrust law.
The nominal-adapter condition measures the adapter path without applying a fault and must not be substituted with old nominal data.
The queue order is fixed and randomized before the first v2 trial; scientific failures are retained and are not automatically retried.
